test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the term from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

ABCD, ABCD1, ABC1D1, AB1C1D1, A1B1C1D1, A1B1C1D2, ?
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:**
 A number is added after the alphabets in the reverse order and after the numbers are placed the number is increased by 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65676612e8977e70e6dfdbe1ec41de1904a670b7a22b65ff0446f8d483908f1f.png] 

Hence the correct answer is **option 3)**
